name: release-notes-suite
description: Two-stage release pipeline for TargetCRM / Notify360 (ConstellationDealer). harvester builds the complete engineering release inventory (every shipped story/defect across both boards plus non-ticketed PR/commit deployments); releaser turns an inventory or technical draft into dealer-facing release notes in the support-team house style, with Notify360 and TargetCRM brand variants.
